archetype: 6 (Vibrant Play) combined with Neo-Brutalist elements for structured modern contrast.
design_philosophy: Neo-Brutalist Event Hub. Bold, unapologetic, and highly structured. Combines raw energy (stark black borders, heavy shadows, vibrant category colors) with organized clarity (bento grids, clean typography) to make finding and submitting events an exciting, tactile experience. We avoid standard soft SaaS shadows in favor of aggressive, playful geometry.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing within structured containers. Sharp edges. No soft blurring.

grid_strategy.homepage_hero: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris). Asymmetrical overlapping or varied span sizes. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6.

surface_strategies.cards: Neo-Brutalist: Flat white or vibrant background, border-2 border-black, shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]. rounded-none or rounded-sm.
surface_strategies.buttons: border-2 border-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 hover:-translate-x-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] active:translate-y-0 active:translate-x-0 active:shadow-none
surface_strategies.inputs: bg-white border-2 border-black p-4 text-base focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-accent/20 focus:border-accent shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]
surface_strategies.badges: px-3 py-1 border-2 border-black text-xs font-bold uppercase shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]

animations.hover: Mechanical, tactile snaps. Instant translation with bouncy shadow expansion. Do not use slow fades.
animations.page_load: Staggered slide up for lists. Hard cuts over soft dissolves.
animations.scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll highly recommended for momentum.

component_guidelines.header: Solid background (white or pastel) with a hard 2px black bottom border. Sticky top. z-50. Navigation must be visible on desktop, no hamburger unless mobile.
component_guidelines.event_card: Top half: Image with aggressive 2px border bottom separating it from content. Bottom half: Content area with Event Title (H3), Date, Location, and Category Badge. Use specific category color for the badge background.
component_guidelines.forms: Use Shadcn customized heavily. Strip all soft radii and subtle shadows. Apply Neo-brutalist solid black borders and heavy box-shadows. Labels must be bold.
component_guidelines.category_filters: Row of buttons. Active state inverts colors (black background, white text) while inactive states retain white background with colored text and black borders.
component_guidelines.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react. Stroke width should be 2px to match borders.

accessibility.contrast: Extremely high. Black borders guarantee separation. Text over images must have solid background plates or heavy black text-shadow.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-4 focus:ring-accent focus:outline-none on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-event-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do not use 'Inter' for headings. Install and apply 'Clash Display' or 'Cabinet Grotesk' via font-face or Google Fonts.
2. All cards, buttons, and inputs MUST follow the Neo-Brutalist shadow style: `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]` and `border-2 border-black`.
3. Apply specific category colors to their respective badges: Music (Blue #2563EB), Sports (Green #22C55E), Cultural (Orange #F97316), Food (Yellow #EAB308).
4. Use the provided high-quality image URLs in the exact locations specified by their category descriptions. DO NOT use placeholder services like via.placeholder.com.
5. Ensure the homepage has an asymmetrical 'bento grid' for featured events, mixing large vertical, large horizontal, and small square blocks.

6. Build the Event Submission Form and Registration modals using Shadcn UI, but OVERRIDE their default styles to match the Neo-brutalist theme (remove border-radius, add heavy borders, solid shadows).
7. Include `data-testid` attributes on every single clickable element, button, and form input (e.g. data-testid='event-category-filter-music', data-testid='register-button').
